messages:
Takeshi S: Hi all, Takeshi here (new today). My calendar shows two "New Hire Orientation" events at 08:00 but one is 08:00 JST and the other 08:00 ET. The JST one has the Zoom link, the ET one just says 'Add conferencing'. Which should I join? I'm in Tokyo. @Renee any guidance?

Renee: Welcome Takeshi! :wave: If you're in Tokyo, join the session that converts to 22:00 JST (global PeopleOps). The invite that contains the Zoom link is the canonical one. Sounds like a timezone metadata mismatch created a duplicate.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Global New Hire Orientation at 08:00 AM ET. Zoom join URL: https://zoom.redwood.com/orientation/may2026 Passcode: 2580. Recording uploaded to Confluence under /onboarding/recordings within 60 minutes post-session. If your invite lacks conferencing data, check the PeopleOps calendar or ping here.

Takeshi S: Thanks. On desktop I see both overlapping; on mobile I only see the one with the link. The duplicate messes up reminders.

IT Support: Hey Takeshi  this happens when one invite was generated with organizer tz=America/New_York and another with tz=Asia/Tokyo (or UTC). Some calendar clients render both. Quick fixes: (1) delete both events and re-add the invite that contains the Zoom link; (2) edit one event -> set explicit timezone dropdown to Eastern Time to match the other and save. We'll also resend a normalized invite.

Khalid: For Outlook users: open the duplicate -> Edit event -> Time zones -> pick the canonical timezone (Eastern Time) and save. That usually merges duplicates without deleting.

Renee: IT, can you resend to new-hires-may2026 with conferenceData/joinUrl and include the passcode in the description so older clients pick it up? Also please add a recording placeholder: https://confluence.redwood.com/onboarding/recordings/2026-05.

IT Support: Will do resending now with timezone=America/New_York for the global event, conferenceData/joinUrl, and embedding the passcode in the description and ICS text. We'll also ensure the generated ICS includes the conferenceData block so Outlook/Google pick it up consistently. New invites should arrive within 5 minutes. If you still see two events, remove both and re-add from the updated invite and DM screenshots.

Takeshi S: New invite landed and looks good. Deleted the old ones and re-added the new invite. Zoom link and passcode visible, time shows 22:00 JST correctly. Thanks everyone!

Khalid: Confirmed fixed for me too. Recording placeholder is present. Welcome aboard Takeshi! :tada:

PeopleOps Bot: Recording will be uploaded to Confluence under /onboarding/recordings within 60 minutes after session end. If you miss it, book a 1:1 catch-up via the "New Hire Catch-up" calendar event.
